source.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing, no spoken words. Music for a cheerful 3D adventure game for kids aged 4 to 8, 'Rota Brava'. Fixed palette: ukulele, marimba, nylon-string acoustic guitar, upright bass played pizzicato, light accordion, glockenspiel, soft hand percussion (cajon, shaker, tambourine); no electric guitar, no synths, no drum kit, no orchestra hits. Main theme (leitmotif): a short bright hummable motif in F major: rising leap C-F-A (up a fourth then a third), a step down to G, then a jump up to high C; rhythm two eighth notes, a quarter, an eighth, a dotted quarter; answered by a gentle descending phrase back to F. Scene: sunny seaside village by day, kids exploring the harbour and the market. Marimba carries the main theme, ukulele strums on the offbeat, pizzicato bass, light shaker and cajon; accordion answers the theme in the second half. Key: F major. Tempo: 100 BPM, steady, no tempo changes. Energy 2/3. 4/4, two 8-bar phrases, the theme stated clearly twice. Warm, friendly, playful and safe for small children; never scary, never aggressive. Clean acoustic mix, intimate room, no heavy reverb. Seamless loop: ends ready to restart from the beginning, no fade-out.
